title: Remove Parent Field From Type And Design
description: Remove the `parent` field from Type and Design structs (and their Meta/Shallow/Diff/DTO variants) in `compose/rs/lib.rs`. Keep Folder's parent field. Remove all related conversion, clone, PartialEq, apply_diff, diff computation, SQLite read/write, merkle hash, default/test constructors, isEmpty checks, guid remapping, and inverse diff computation code.
